data.name: Thunderburst
data.description: As a standard action, you can create a blast of air accompanied by a loud peal of thunder. The blast has a range of 100 feet and has a %1-foot radius. Creatures in the area take %2d6 points of bludgeoning damage and are deafened for 1 hour, with a Fortitude save (DC %3) resulting in half damage and no deafness. You can use this ability %4 time(s) per day.|OracleThunderburstRadius|OracleThunderburstDice|OracleRevelationDC|OracleThunderburstTimes
